title: Winnie | Hooded Layering Cardigan for Every Season
bodyHtml:
This is the hooded cardigan you'll reach for constantly—whether you're layering through cooler months or wearing it solo when the weather softens. It's warm enough to do the heavy lifting on mild days, yet light enough to throw over anything without bulk. The kind of piece that adapts to your life, your weather, and your wardrobe without fuss.

Why you'll love it

  • The perfect layering piece when you need extra warmth—slip it over a tee, blouse or jumper without adding weight
  • Soft and breathable, so it keeps you cosy from morning to night without feeling restrictive
  • Works open or closed, pairing effortlessly with jeans, trousers, dresses or skirts for an instant polished look
  • Generous hooded design adds warmth and a relaxed, casual vibe
  • All-day comfort whether you're at home, at work, out for a walk or travelling
  • Limited stock from our Anniversary Collection—once it's gone, it's gone
  • Available now in your size

Over 50,000 women have already chosen us, with an average rating of 4.8 out of 5. Your happiness and your trust mean everything to us.
